heading: Sergeant at Arms of House; additional compensation
lead: The Sergeant at Arms of the House of Representatives shall receive, directly or indirectly, no fees or other compensation or emolument whatever for performing the duties of the office, or in connection therewith, otherwise than the salary prescribed by law.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 77 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
Similar ProvisionsProvisions similar to those in this section were also contained in act Mar. 3, 1875, ch. 129, 18 Stat. 346.
